United Nations S/RES/2784 (2025) Security Council Distr.: General 2 July 2025

Resolution 2784 (2025) Adopted by the Security Council at its 9952nd meeting, on 2 July 2025

The Security Council, Noting the resignation as a member of the International Court of Justice of Judge Abdulqawi Ahmed Yusuf, effective 30 September 2025, Noting further that a vacancy in the International Court of Justice for the remainder of the term of office of Judge Yusuf will occur and must be filled in accordance with the terms of the Statute of the Court, Noting that, in accordance with article 14 of the Statute, the date of the election to fill the vacancy shall be fixed by the Security Council, Decides that the election to fill the vacancy shall take place on 12 November 2025 at a meeting of the Security Council and at a meeting of the General Assembly at its eightieth session.

25-10868 (E) *2510868*
